operations.comment: ; California Games (NES, UxROM mapper 2, 8 x 16 KiB PRG, CHR-RAM) - commented reading/build source.
; Commentary rounds 1-6. Built from commentary/before/game.asm + commentary/annotations.txt by
; analysis/tools/cmt_apply.py; edit the annotations, not this file, so rebuilds stay reproducible.
; Program structure (from round-1 analysis):
; - Reset: the vector at $FFB0 (ResetVector) selects bank 0 and jumps to PowerOnReset ($86ED): clear RAM
; (zero page $00-$20 is kept), silence the APU, restore/seed the high-score table (bank 3), start
; song 0 and build the licence screen.
; - Almost all game logic runs inside the NMI. NmiHandler (bank 7) either runs only the sound driver
; (NmiState bit 7 set, used while screens are being built with rendering off) or selects bank 0 and
; jumps to FrameDispatch, which resets the stack and jumps through FrameHandlerTable by NmiState.
; Each frame handler ends by jumping to IdleLoop, an endless loop waiting for the next NMI.
; - Every switchable bank starts with the bytes 00..07 (bus-conflict table used by the bank-select
; writes "sta $8000,y" with Y = bank) followed by a jump table at $8008 (3 bytes per entry; bank 0
; has a single unused slot, Bank0Entry0). CallBank0..CallBank7 (BIT-skip entry chain in the fixed
; bank) take Y = $08 + 3 * entry index.
; - Event order (CurrentEvent): 0 half pipe, 1 foot bag, 2 surfing, 3 skating, 4 BMX, 5 flying disk,
; 6 = all events done. Event start routines are reached through MenuActionTable.
; - Zero page $91-$E2 is an overlay work area: each event reuses it with its own meaning. Names in
; that range are scoped to the code that uses them and prefixed with the event (Skate*, Bmx*,
; Surf*, Disk*, Pipe*; foot bag uses Kicker*, Bag*, FootBag* and Gull*; the bank 6 course builders
; use Course*, the flying-disk scroller Parallax*). The same address therefore appears under
; different names in different events; each name is listed with its event in the equates below.
; - Operands written as Name+n are exact offsets into a named RAM array or table (e.g. OamTile+4 is
; sprite 1's tile, TerrainTableA+32 a 32-byte row). Tables that code reads as Name,X with X never
; near 0 (index-offset aliases, 20 of them) are defined at the end of the file as
; Name = Name_XX - $XX, where the label Name_XX marks the first byte really read (index $XX).
; - Branch labels: most are generated as Owner_Skip/Owner_Loop (forward/backward target inside the
; routine Owner); the main event frame routines, the course object code, SurfBuildWave, NameEntryFrame,
; FootBagUpdatePose and SkateFrame_Finish use descriptive names. Generated names are exact about
; direction (Loop = backward target, Skip = forward, Return = an rts) but say nothing about purpose.
; - The 3 bytes at bank 0 $BFFE-$BFFF + bank 7 $C000 are one observed instruction that the map format
; cannot express (toolkit issue TK-04). By an explicit user-directed fallback they are mapped as
; generic Data (Manual provenance, meaning unknown) and emitted as raw bytes; that is not a proven
; data role.
; Uncertain interpretations are worded tentatively; mechanical "Entry/Calls/Reads/Writes" lines are
; generated from the code itself and are exact for the listed instructions.
; ---- Hardware registers ----
; ---- Controller bit masks (JoyHeld/JoyPressed, read order A,B,Select,Start,Up,Down,Left,Right) ----
; ---- RAM variables (CPU RAM $0000-$07FF) ----

; Phase 1: iNES header: NES<1A>, 8x16K PRG, 0 CHR (CHR-RAM), flags 0x21/0x00 -> mapper 2, vertical mirroring (run.py inspect).
; Phase 1 (round 2, L-R1R-02): bus-conflict identity table 00..07 (bank-select writes sta $8000,y).
; Referenced by: PowerOnReset (data at +0), ResetVector (data at +0), NmiHandler (data at +0), FarCall (data at +0), BeginScreenSetup (data at +0)
; Bank 0 jump-table slot 0. Banks 1-6 start with the 00-07 bus-conflict table, a run of 3-byte JMP
; entries at $8008 and the copyright text; bank 0 has exactly one 3-byte slot here, holding
; "jsr UpdateSound" instead of a JMP. Nothing calls it (CallBank0 and Y = $08 into bank 0 are both
; unused). If it were ever called it would return into the copyright text below, so it is at best a
; vestigial entry. Classified as code at low confidence (round 3, L-R3-01).
; Bank0Entry0  [bank 0 $8008, physical 24]
; Entry: no static caller found (entered by fall-through, indirect jump or observed execution).
; Calls: UpdateSound.
; Phase 1: ASCII text ' (C) COPYRIGHT 1987 RARE LTD. ENGLAND. '.
; Wait for the sprite-0 hit flag (PPUSTATUS bit 6) to be set; used to time mid-frame splits.
; WaitSprite0Clear  [bank 0 $8032, physical 66]
; Entry: 1 JSR site(s). Exit: RTS. Hardware: PPUSTATUS.
; Busy-wait loop: X inner and Y outer iterations (about 5*X*Y cycles). Used for raster timing.
; DelayXY  [bank 0 $803D, physical 77]
; Entry: 31 JSR site(s). Exit: RTS.
; Title-screen raster effect: mid-frame palette rewrites and OAM DMA between timed delays.
; TitlePaletteEffect  [bank 0 $8044, physical 84]
; Entry: 1 JSR site(s). Exit: RTS. Calls: CopyPaletteData, CyclePaletteEntry, DelayXY,
; WaitSprite0Clear. Hardware: OAMADDR, OAMDMA, PPUADDR, PPUCTRL, PPUDATA, PPUMASK, PPUSCROLL,
; PPUSTATUS.
; Frame handler $04 (half pipe): on odd frames upload 7 nametable columns from TerrainTableB;
; on even frames call bank 1 entry 0 and update two palette entries; then HalfPipeFrame.
; HalfPipeVblank  [bank 0 $8192, physical 418]
; Entry: indirect-jump table target. Exit: falls through into HalfPipeVblank_Done. Calls:
; CallBank1, DelayXY. Reads: FrameCounter, Temp0, PipeDroppedIn, PipeRiderShown, PipeReactColor,
; PipeReactColor2, TerrainTableB, TerrainTableB+32, TerrainTableB+64, TerrainTableB+96,
